why: In A a line cuts a small piece off the top of the square, and in B that small top piece is removed, leaving only the big part. In C the line cuts off the tip of the house roof, so removing it leaves a five-sided shape with a slanted top, which is option 2. Option 3 is tempting but it is the full house; the tip was not removed. Option 1 is only the piece that should be thrown away.
trick: When a figure has a cutting line, the answer usually keeps the big part and drops the small part above or beside the line.
